subject: POC trial: model selection and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today — that was really helpful to understand Acme's goals for conversational product Q&A on mobile and web. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Business goal: reduce support load and increase discoverability of product answers in checkout flows.
- Key success criteria you mentioned: relevancy > 90% on curated product QA set, P95 latency < 300ms in Redwood sandbox, and safe handling of policy-sensitive questions.
- Data available: product catalogue JSON + 3k annotated Q/A pairs (you said you'll share a sample).
- Multilingual requirement: English + Spanish (primary), occasional Portuguese later.

Proposed POC (2 weeks):
1) Week 0 (kickoff & access): share data sample and sandbox access; sign trial agreement.
2) Week 1 (integration): ingest product catalogue, run baseline with two candidate open models, set up evaluation harness.
3) Week 2 (eval & tuning): run eval set, measure relevancy/latency/cost, iterate prompts & reranking.

Model recommendations (first pass):
- Primary: Llama-2-13b-chat (q4_0, optimized on Redwood) — good tradeoff for instruction-following and multilingual prompts.
- Fallback: Falcon-7B-Instruct (q4_0) — lower cost, faster, useful for degraded-case routing.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and share the data sample and a point of contact on your engineering side? Once you confirm I'll send the formal POC plan and schedule a 30-minute kickoff for early next week.

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (blank template I promised to fill after your confirmation)

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-retail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's discovery call

Ben —

Thanks for the recap, that looks right. A couple clarifications and notes from our side: 

- Success criteria: aim for relevance >= 90% on our 1k pilot QA set; allow up to 5% false-positive safety flags (we'll mark edge cases). Latency target P95 < 350ms given our current CDN.
- Data: attaching a 10MB sample export with product JSON and ~300 QA pairs (acme_data_sample.zip). We'll share full 3k set after NDA.
- Multilingual: English first, Spanish second. For Spanish we prefer a single-model approach if possible (vs. translation + English inference).
- Compliance/Procurement: procurement will need a short SOW and trial terms. I'll introduce procurement contact after we finalize the plan.

Can you include an evaluation plan that measures both relevancy and hallucination rate, and propose an owner at Redwood for technical setup?

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Product Manager — Search & Discovery
Acme Retail
sofia@acme-retail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & model selection (attached)

Sofia —

Appreciate the sample and clarifications. Attached is the POC plan (redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf) with timelines and responsibilities. Key bits inline: 

Evaluation plan (how we'll measure success):
- Relevance: top-1 exact/soft match vs. gold answers on your 1k pilot set; target >= 90%.
- Hallucination rate: fraction of model responses that include unsupported assertions; target < 5% on the pilot set.
- Latency: P95 token-response < 350ms in our sandbox (we'll report P50/P95).
- Cost: estimated tokens and per-request unit cost; target keep incremental cost under $X per 1k requests (detailed in the PDF).

Model selection rationale: 
- Primary model: Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized q4_0) — supports instruction-following and is performant on Redwood's runtime; good mix of cost/quality for English+Spanish with prompt engineering.
- Fallback model: Falcon-7B-Instruct (q4_0) — used for lower-cost or burst routing; will be configured as an automatic fallback when latency spikes or token budgets exceed thresholds.
- Multilingual approach: we'll test single-model Spanish prompts first (Llama-2-13b-chat). If Spanish quality lags on the pilot, fall back to a two-step flow (lightweight translation to English -> inference -> back-translate) or evaluate a multilingual model variant (we can spin up an M2M100 translation-assisted pipeline on request).

Ownership & timeline: 
- Redwood PM/eng owner: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer) — technical lead for integration and evaluations.
- Redwood contact for kickoff/procurement: me for commercial, Jordan for onboarding.
- Proposed timeline: Kickoff Mon 2026-08-31; Baseline run by 2026-09-03; Final eval and review by 2026-09-10.

Next steps (for Acme):
1) Confirm SOW/AGREEMENT for trial (I can send a short SOW + trial terms for signature).
2) Share full 3k QA set and procurement contact.
3) Confirm kickoff attendee list (engineer + product).

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan), acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (filled template in next email)

Let us know if the timeline looks tight — we can stretch to 3 weeks if you need extra engineering time.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & model selection (attached)

Looping in technical notes and an internal checklist for the POC. Agree with recommended models and fallback routing. A few action items for Redwood engineering and Acme: 

- I'll provision a sandbox cluster with the Llama-2-13b-chat q4_0 build and a Falcon-7B-Instruct q4_0 pool for fallback testing.
- Need API key (we'll provide a scoped trial key) + an S3 bucket or a drive link for the full 3k dataset. Sofia: can you confirm share permissions for the drive?
- I'll run a baseline eval using your 1k pilot set and produce the evaluation CSV with columns: input, gold_answer, model_response, relevancy_score, hallucination_flag, latency_ms.
- For Spanish: I'll run both single-model and translation-assisted flows. If single-model is >5% worse on relevance, we'll recommend the translation pipeline as a short-term fix.
- Dev time estimate: setup ~= 2 engineer-days; baseline eval run and initial tuning ~= 3 engineer-days.

Attachments: poc_setup_steps.md (setup checklist). I'll update the SOW with these technical notes before Ben sends to procurement.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
